_comment: Tier-2 for _general.vtk_time_series_measured.Signal. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 2 s in a temp dir: ten calls to gridView.writeVTK('overwritten', pointdata=...) left exactly ONE file, ['overwritten.vtu'] — each call overwrites the last, which is the whole claim. The same ten steps with number=step produced ten files whose first three are series00000.vtu, series00001.vtu, series00002.vtu, i.e. a zero-padded five-digit suffix. No .pvd collection file was written, so ParaView has to open the sequence by pattern. dune.grid.OutputType exposes exactly appendedbase64, appendedraw, ascii, base64, and outputType=OutputType.ascii produced a .vtu whose head contains '<VTKFile'. The fixture has a synthetic physics key because the claim lives in the _general measured sections, not in a pitfalls list. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 passes number=step in the trap loop, so the ten calls leave ten files. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations "same_name_file_list=['overwritten.vtu']", 'same_name_leaves_one_frame=True', 'dune_vtk_time_series_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
